subject.title: RFC: Skill routing metadata and evaluation hints for Harness-style OpenClaw setups

question: Should ClawHub introduce a narrow advisory routing-metadata v1 now, and should risk, verification, and playbook declarations be deferred until their trust semantics are separately designed?
rationale: The repository vision supports ClawHub-owned discovery and public metadata, but it also reserves runtime execution for OpenClaw; source and docs do not establish which author-declared safety or completion claims ClawHub should expose or trust.

options.title: Approve advisory routing v1
options.body: Add a minimal optional routing schema and expose raw values through API/CLI, while explicitly deferring risk, verification, and playbook claims.

options.title: Design full registry contract first
options.body: Specify routing, risk, verification, quality controls, and downstream trust semantics together before adding any public fields.

options.title: Defer metadata expansion
options.body: Keep current semantic search and runtime-requirement metadata until concrete consumer demand and evaluation evidence justify a new contract.

recommendation.title: Approve advisory routing v1
recommendation.body: Add a minimal optional routing schema and expose raw values through API/CLI, while explicitly deferring risk, verification, and playbook claims.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged manifest-metadata work is the closest concrete precedent for assessing an additive schema direction, though the final product decision remains broader than that contribution.
